media.empty_state_illustration: Use simple geometric vector shapes in #18181B with a subtle 1px border

instructions_to_main_agent: All text, labels, and placeholders MUST be in Italian.
Use standard HTML tags (div, section, main, header, nav) styled with Tailwind CSS to construct the core layouts. Limit the use of full-screen background colors; instead use the deep zinc-950 base.
Implement bottom tab navigation using lucide-react icons. Ensure fixed positioning at the bottom with z-index 50 and add pb-24 to the main content area to prevent overlap.
Avoid Shadcn Card component. Create custom cards with div elements using 'bg-zinc-900 rounded-2xl p-6 border border-zinc-800/50'. DO NOT USE box-shadows, keep the design flat and clean.
For the quick notes section (Note), use framer-motion to implement swipe gestures.
Categorized elements (calendar events, notes) should use the defined category colors with low opacity backgrounds (10%) and border/text in the matching solid color.
Use Outfit for Headings and Manrope for Body. Install via standard web fonts if necessary, or use fallback sans-serif with aggressive tracking-tight for headers.
All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute in kebab-case.
